launch.credential_boundary: authorized user-owned Agent SDK runtime; no service-account impersonation

schema_and_health_probe.version: sidecar artifact hash plus Claude Code and Agent SDK package versions
schema_and_health_probe.schema: sidecar contract digest plus SDK options/message compatibility probe
schema_and_health_probe.health: start one read-only disposable query and observe init, message, result, and cleanup
schema_and_health_probe.negative_capability_challenge: request one optional hook, subagent, or resume property outside the admitted profile and require a typed non-success

model_selection.discovery: current runtime/account capability probe; unknown when the SDK does not expose an authoritative list
model_selection.selection: ClaudeAgentOptions.model or equivalent sidecar request field, recorded per attempt

session_control.start: query or ClaudeSDKClient connect with a new ELIOT attempt
session_control.resume: SDK resume/session identifier through the sidecar
session_control.fork: SDK fork-session option when the exact runtime probe admits it
session_control.cancel: sidecar cancellation mapped to SDK interruption/close and process-tree reconciliation

event_contract.source: Agent SDK init, assistant, tool, hook, subagent, result, error, and cleanup events
event_contract.ordering: sidecar stream sequence plus SDK session/message identities wrapped in ELIOT EventEnvelope

child_agents.native_surface: Agent SDK subagents declared in the exact attempt options

execution_routes.proof_ceiling: The local sidecar may execute one bounded candidate attempt. Claude Code plugin hooks observe or gate a host session but do not own SDK attempt state, finish, or recovery.

launch.credential_boundary: separate explicit remote credential, billing, retention, and privacy profile

schema_and_health_probe.version: remote API version and adapter hash
schema_and_health_probe.negative_capability_challenge: unsupported beta operation must fail without fallback to the local route

model_selection.selection: remote job route field recorded per attempt

session_control.cancel: remote job cancellation plus outcome reconciliation

event_contract.source: remote job events and terminal readback
event_contract.ordering: provider job sequence wrapped in ELIOT EventEnvelope

child_agents.native_surface: remote beta behavior is not admitted

execution_routes.proof_ceiling: Deferred remote capacity is a separate route and may not inherit local subscription, privacy, event, or continuation claims.

probe_requirements: pin Claude Code executable, Agent SDK package, sidecar artifact, account, and behavior-affecting options
prove read-only start, streamed events, result, cancellation, cleanup, resume, and optional fork independently
prove hook output and SDK event output are not merged into one terminal status
prove every admitted subagent has a WorkItem and descendant closure before parent disposition
prove local and remote routes have separate credentials, billing, retention, and ActualRouteReceipt
known_gaps: the local Agent SDK sidecar is not implemented in this profile change
the existing Claude Code plugin invokes the legacy bridge per hook and is not the SDK route
current-account model discovery, quota, resume, and fork behavior are unprobed
remote Managed Agents remain a separate deferred beta route
